note: Canonical objection taxonomy for B2B outbound replies. Tool-agnostic. The 9 ids below are frozen: analyze.py refuses any type not in this list, because a typo would silently create a phantom category that accumulates forever.

boundary_rule.objection: A blocker raised by someone who is still engaging. Only these 9 types count in the objection ranking.
not_an_objection: wrong_fit — the person disqualifies themselves. Counted and ranked in the reply mix, with its own segmentation verdict. Never mixed into objection share.
not_interested — a refusal with no stated blocker. Nothing to coach. Counted in the reply mix, watched as a rate.

families.solution: They have, or think they have, the problem covered.
families.commercial: The trade is wrong: price, moment, or believability.
families.process: The path to a decision is blocked, or the job left the building.
families.trust: The channel itself is the problem.

types.label: Already equipped
sounds_like: we're happy with our current setup

types.label: Tried, didn't work
sounds_like: we tested this two years ago
we burned a budget on that

types.label: Price / budget
sounds_like: what's the cost?  (as a blocker, not a question)

types.label: Doesn't believe the outcome
sounds_like: sounds too good to be true

types.label: Not my call / procurement
sounds_like: I'd need to run it past X

types.label: How did you get this / spam
sounds_like: where did you get my number?

segmentation_verdict_map.wrong-person: Wrong seniority or wrong function targeted — fix the title filter.
segmentation_verdict_map.not-icp-segment: Wrong industry or company size — fix the segment filter.
segmentation_verdict_map.not-icp-junior: Seniority filter too loose — raise the floor.
segmentation_verdict_map.job-seeker: List source is polluted — check where the audience came from.

cross_skill_mapping.note: One-way lookup: given another skill's label, find this skill's card. Their own classification contracts are untouched.

reply-draft-assistant._unmapped_rule: No sub-type exists on their side. Apply the card only when the objection text clearly matches; otherwise stay on their 5 sub-types.

team-performance-dashboard._status: Aligned on the nine objection sub-type ids and on WRONG_FIT, so both skills report the same objection sub-type distribution. Their top levels still differ: that skill classifies replies into five buckets, this one into eight, so the share-of-replies denominators are not comparable.

smokescreen_markers.rule: Any 2 of 3 fire -> likely smokescreen. Not a type, a per-instance flag.
smokescreen_markers.pre_information: The objection lands in the thread's FIRST received message, before any substantive exchange.
smokescreen_markers.no_specifics: No figure, no tool named, no date, no stated constraint.
smokescreen_markers.immediate_drop: The thread dies after our reply even though the reply scored >= 22/27.
